title: Competency entry
description: One entry in a personal competency-state.yaml's `competencies` array. Enforces the three-independent-dimension model (Section 9 of the transformation spec) — knowledge, professional, and repository must never be collapsed into a single field.

id.description: Stable semantic ID, e.g. competency.mobile.appium — independent of file path.

professional.description: Either a flat {status} or a multi-facet breakdown (execution/planning/framework_development/etc.) — at least one professional-status-shaped field is required.
